## What problem does this solve?

Describe the trigger and the behavior before and after this change. Link an issue if there is one.

## How was it tested?

List the checks actually run. Distinguish synthetic tests from real Google account/hardware testing. Include a regression test for a bug fix where practical.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This PR stays focused on Google Meet, Google accounts and macOS, or its scope was discussed first.
- [ ] Relevant setup or troubleshooting documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, browser profiles, attendee information or real meeting links are included.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this code and any assets under the MIT license.

Draft PRs and first-time contributions are welcome. State any known gaps rather than hiding them.
